usedFor: EyeLevel AI holds buckets and ingested documents, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ingest Document” in EyeLevel AI, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new ingested document can start a script on your own machine, so follow-up work happens locally.

watchOut: “New Ingest Document” in EyeLevel AI is polling, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check.
